question: The p-nitrobenzoic acid is:

options.opc: More acid than benzoic acid and with lower pKa.
options.opd: More acid than benzoic acid and with higher pKa.
options.ope: Less acid than p-methoxybenzoic acid and with lower pKa.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: p-nitrobenzoic acid -> contains a nitro group -> can exhibit different acidity compared to benzoic acid -> 70% confidence CHAIN: p-nitrobenzoic acid -> undergoes resonance stabilization -> affects its acid strength -> 80% confidence CHAIN: p-nitrobenzoic acid -> has a different electronic effect due to the nitro group -> influences its acidity compared to benzoic acid -> 70%
analysis: p-nitrobenzoic acid is more acidic than benzoic acid due to the presence of the nitro group which is electron-withdrawing, leading to a lower pKa value.
